title: Packed opening at the Cookery and the rave reviews
summary: She did the New Year's Eve show for Barney Josephson, and after she began at the Cookery she received big reviews. Returning from Louisville she found people lined up in the snow and Moe had to bring her in.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: But Helen when you had all those rave reviews, John Wilson, well everybody because you had big rave reviews because of your appearance at The Cookery. Must that have been for the New Year's Eve show? Maybe it was.
Well I did the New Year's Eve show, but then right after I started in the Cookery is when I started getting all these big raves.
Well tell me, when you came back from Louisville after you had gone home because your father had died, you said that you couldn't get into the place.

Yeah I couldn't. And I saw people lined up around both corners and I said, 'I wonder what's going on in here'. And so I went there and they didn't want to let me in and Moe had to come to the door and get me. And they said, 'let the lady in. This is Miss Humes'. And people started getting out of their way and they let me. And I said, well I ain't never seen nothing like that. And I never have seen nothing like that. And
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
everybody was just so nice. It was some opening. And the weather was bad. There was snow all on the ground and everything and everybody is standing out there in the snow. It was in January.
And that gave Barney (Josephson) a new lease on life, didn't it?
I mean, after that - that was home for you. I mean you're on your way back there now, aren't you?
Yes, I open there on the 16th.
And you're going to bring Sir Charles back? When he comes back he's going to be there with you.
Sir Charles, he hasn't been recognized here in America.
No, no he hasn't. Even amongst the musicians he doesn't get the credit, does he?
